Commands

# mcp

Start a local Sentry MCP server

## Usage

Section titled “Usage”

### `sentry mcp [<org/project>]`

Section titled “sentry mcp [<org/project>]”

Start a local Sentry MCP server

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[<org/project>]` | <org>/ (an organization) or <org>/<project> to limit calls to |

**Options:**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--org <org>` | Limit every call to this organization |
| `--project <project>` | Limit calls to this project |
| `--skills <skills>` | Skills to grant, comma-separated (default: active skills; seer is left out on self-hosted) |
| `--all-skills` | Grant every active skill, including seer on self-hosted |
| `--disable-skills <disable-skills>` | Skills to remove, comma-separated |
| `--experimental` | Enable forward-looking tool variants and experimental features |
| `--agent-provider <agent-provider>` | LLM provider for AI-powered search: openai, azure-openai, anthropic, or openrouter |
| `--openai-base-url <openai-base-url>` | OpenAI API base URL |
| `--openai-model <openai-model>` | OpenAI model (default: gpt-5) |
| `--anthropic-base-url <anthropic-base-url>` | Anthropic API base URL |
| `--anthropic-model <anthropic-model>` | Anthropic model (default: claude-sonnet-5-5) |
| `--mcp-url <mcp-url>` | MCP server URL reported in telemetry |

**Examples:**

```
# Start the server with the current CLI loginsentry mcp
# Limit every call to one organizationsentry mcp acme/
# Limit calls to one projectsentry mcp acme/web
# Grant every skill, including seer on self-hostedsentry mcp --all-skills
# Grant only some skillssentry mcp --skills inspect,triage
# Pick the LLM provider for AI-powered searchsentry mcp --agent-provider anthropic
```

All commands support `--json` for machine-readable output and `--fields` to select specific JSON fields.

`sentry mcp` starts the local stdio Sentry MCP server using the active Sentry CLI session. Authenticate once with `sentry auth login`; no separate MCP login or token cache is required.

## Configure an MCP client

Section titled “Configure an MCP client”

Point your MCP client at the installed Sentry CLI:

```
{  "mcpServers": {    "sentry": {      "command": "sentry",      "args": ["mcp"]    }  }}
```

For a self-hosted instance, first authenticate the CLI against that host. You can also pick the instance for this MCP server with `SENTRY_HOST` or `SENTRY_URL` (an `http://` URL for plain HTTP), the same as for other commands:

```
{  "mcpServers": {    "sentry": {      "command": "sentry",      "args": ["mcp"],      "env": {        "SENTRY_HOST": "sentry.example.com"      }    }  }}
```

`--host`, `--url`, and `--insecure-http` still work but are deprecated.

Pass `<org>/` to limit every call to one organization, or `<org>/<project>` to one project:

```
{  "mcpServers": {    "sentry": {      "command": "sentry",      "args": ["mcp", "acme/web"]    }  }}
```

`--org` and `--project` do the same; a target and a flag that name different values are an error. A bare `acme` is refused, because other commands read it as a project search: pass `acme/` for the organization. The target takes no URL; pick the Sentry instance with `SENTRY_HOST` or `SENTRY_URL`.
